thesis_text: Graph-based AI scientist systems can accelerate real materials discovery.

case.name: Benchmark evidence remains proxy
case.description: Benchmark sources must not be treated as direct discovery evidence.
case.expected_behavior: Evidence from benchmark sources is classified as proxy and the benchmark leap is preserved.

results.message: Benchmark evidence is bounded as proxy evidence.

case.name: A6 requires direct prospective validation
case.description: Prospective validation should remain unsupported without independent direct evidence.
case.expected_behavior: A6 support is unsupported with low confidence when no direct validation exists.

results.message: A6 remains appropriately low without direct validation.

case.name: Company claims remain anecdotal
case.description: Product/company claims cannot become validated outcomes without independent evidence.
case.expected_behavior: Company-claim evidence is anecdotal and generates a claim-to-validation leap.

results.message: Company claims remain anecdotal and bounded.

case.name: Conflict/failure links are present
case.description: The eval workshop must link conflicts, invalid leaps, verifier failures, and evals.
case.expected_behavior: Workshop links include invalid-leap, conflict, and verifier failure edges.

results.message: Conflict and failure links are present in the eval workshop.

case.name: Replay does not increase overcredited confidence
case.description: Replay after applying the generated eval should lower or preserve confidence.
case.expected_behavior: Replay outcomes pass and confidence does not increase after eval application.

results.message: Replay lowers or preserves confidence after eval application.

generated_eval_fixtures.failure_observed: The system risked accepting this inference: Benchmark QA performance -> real scientific discovery.
generated_eval_fixtures.root_cause: Benchmark performance must be bounded as proxy evidence. It does not establish prospective discovery, novelty, experimental validation, or real-world acceleration.
generated_eval_fixtures.eval_rule: If evidence only reports benchmark or QA performance, classify it as proxy evidence, not direct evidence for real-world discovery acceleration.
generated_eval_fixtures.expected_behavior: The agent should downgrade support, preserve the limitation, and ask for decisive follow-up evidence.

generated_eval_fixtures.failure_observed: The system risked accepting this inference: Plausible hypotheses -> useful novel hypotheses.
generated_eval_fixtures.root_cause: A hypothesis can be plausible but obvious, untestable, false, or low-value.
generated_eval_fixtures.eval_rule: If evidence only reports plausible generated hypotheses, require novelty, testability, and validation before treating it as support for useful discovery.
generated_eval_fixtures.expected_behavior: The agent should downgrade support, preserve the limitation, and ask for decisive follow-up evidence.

generated_eval_fixtures.failure_observed: The system risked accepting this inference: Graph representation -> causal/mechanistic understanding.
generated_eval_fixtures.root_cause: A graph can encode entities, citations, or correlations without encoding causal mechanism.
generated_eval_fixtures.eval_rule: If evidence only shows graph representation or graph retrieval, do not infer causal or mechanistic understanding without ablations.
generated_eval_fixtures.expected_behavior: The agent should downgrade support, preserve the limitation, and ask for decisive follow-up evidence.

generated_eval_fixtures.failure_observed: The system risked accepting this inference: Company claim -> validated outcome.
generated_eval_fixtures.root_cause: A company or product claim is anecdotal unless supported by independent validation.
generated_eval_fixtures.eval_rule: If evidence is a company claim, classify it as anecdotal until independent validation is present.
generated_eval_fixtures.expected_behavior: The agent should downgrade support, preserve the limitation, and ask for decisive follow-up evidence.

generated_eval_fixtures.failure_observed: The system risked accepting this inference: Mixed weak/conflicting sources -> stable discovery belief.
generated_eval_fixtures.root_cause: Cross-source conflicts mean the system must preserve source-type boundaries instead of smoothing weak, contradictory, or promotional evidence into support.
generated_eval_fixtures.eval_rule: Classify the evidence by what it directly measures, not by the stronger thesis it suggests.
generated_eval_fixtures.expected_behavior: The agent should downgrade support, preserve the limitation, and ask for decisive follow-up evidence.
